## Description

One or more faces in a closed shell have their `same_sense` flag (or `FACE_OUTER_BOUND` orientation) inverted relative to the outward direction of the solid; renderer shows inside-out shading; simulation BCs break.

## Reproducer recipe

`MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` where one `ADVANCED_FACE` is referenced with inverted sense (`.F.` instead of `.T.`, or wrong `same_sense` on the face) so its normal points inward.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — orientation-propagation flood-fill from a known-correct seed; reject only if the shell is too disconnected to orient consistently.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject, heal`
